cards.card_text: Now the word of the LORD comes for the scoffers who rule the people in Jerusalem, because they said, "We have made a covenant with death; we have fashioned an agreement with Sheol." Out of EVERYBODY in the world to sign a deal with, they picked DEATH.
cards.verse_text: Therefore hear the word of the LORD, O scoffers who rule this people in Jerusalem. For you said, “We have made a covenant with death; we have fashioned an agreement with Sheol. When the overwhelming scourge passes through it will not touch us, because we have made lies our refuge and falsehood our hiding place.”
